items.title: Schuller Gunther — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer: Steve Schwartz with recording engineer Ken Kimery

ctx.x: Interviewer: Steve Schwartz with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 87 pp.

This is Steve Schwartz from WGBH radio in Boston. We’re at the home of Gunther Schuller on Dudley Road in Newton Centre, Massachusetts, to do an oral history for the Smithsonian Oral History Jazz Program, if that’s the right title. Close enough? Hello Gunther.
